evidence.reason: The blackout gate is evaluated at line 457 before retain/worktree reset/clean, but the paid fixer launch occurs at line 478 with no recheck. Because worktree preparation can consume enough time to move the launch into a GLM peak blackout, the attempt can start when it no longer fits. This is a routine correctness issue; rechecking `blocked(repair)` immediately before `dispatch` and deferring if blocked is the smallest compatible fix.
